title: ICLEF: In-Context Learning with Expert Feedback for Explainable Style Transfer

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on their ability to neutralize subjective biased language from Wikipedia and generate textual explanations of the bias type. The evaluation uses an off-the-shelf DistilBERT bias classifier for neutrality scores, F1 scores for predicting the correct bias category in the explanation, and expert human evaluation for explanation correctness and paraphrase acceptability.
